description: Micron Technology, Inc. is an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all, and with a relentless focus on customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence it delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND and NOR memory and storage products through its Micron and Crucial brands, with the innovations its people create fueling the data economy and enabling advances in artificial intelligence and compute-intensive applications that unleash opportunities from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience. It manufactures its products at wholly-owned facilities and also utilizes subcontractors for certain manufacturing processes, and its global network of manufacturing centers of excellence allows it to benefit from scale while streamlining processes and operations and brings together some of the world's brightest talent to work on the most advanced memory technology. In 2025 it began shipping the industry's first 1-gamma production node, its first DRAM node incorporating EUV lithography, and its High-Bandwidth Memory is a 3D stacked DRAM architecture that uses through-silicon via connections for more efficient communication.
